remarks: Nestled in the Cos Cob neighborhood of Greenwich at the western side of the Mianus River. These fully renovated apartments offer partial views of the Mianus River, alongside some beautiful homes hugging the shoreline. These two-bedroom apartments include all new stainless-steel appliances, and include a living room, primary bedroom, a smaller bedroom that can also be used as a home office, full bath, and washer and dryer. The apartment opens to a large deck offering wonderful views. Both the second and third floor apartments have the exact same layout.  The eat in kitchen opens to the back of the apartment with steps down to the patio for grilling, dining, and entertaining with friends.   Just 35 miles from New York City, close to highways, train station, and public transportation, Greenwich and Stamford shopping, restaurants, parks, library and so much more...These apartments have off street parking and on street parking.
